open_points.subject: enforcement of A6 rule 5 before a new placement
open_points.text: and changes no record and no stored image.
open_points.question: Which module must detect every damaged placement or mark record before a new delivery can call store_image, and how may photo_delivery enforce that guarantee when it knows only rule 4 of A6 while delivery_store owns rule 5?
options: delivery_store exposes one guarded operation that validates both records before it can store an image
photo_delivery reads both records before store_image and therefore must know A6 rule 5
store_image itself checks both records and refuses before writing
open_points.default_guess: Make delivery_store expose a guarded preflight or compound operation, so the owner of A6 rule 5 prevents store_image from running until both records are known to be usable.

witness.initial: A project has no placement record for a valid source, but its corresponding mark file exists and is damaged.
events: The caller asks deliverer_api to deliver the source.
photo_delivery acquires the project lock and finds that the placement record is absent.
One implementation asks delivery_store to validate the mark before storing; another follows the new-placement path without reading a mark because no placement exists.
outcomes: The operation returns STATE_UNAVAILABLE and changes no record and no stored image.
The operation creates the stored image and placement and returns placed, leaving the damaged mark undiscovered.
witness.observer: The caller sees refusal versus placed, and the owner can see the different durable files.
